soak-release-foreground.failure: Foreground soak observed a hidden WebView
soak-release-foreground.profile: packaged release app, real WKWebView with observed visibility, scripted manual refresh/interaction; optional frontend diagnostic counters; no GPU measurement, provider/network or cross-product comparison
soak-release-foreground.diagnosticLimitations: Frontend counters are isolated fixture observations. performance.memory may be unavailable (then no JS heap data is claimed). RSS growth alone cannot identify a leak or its owner.
soak-release-foreground.attribution: Native RSS is exact PID. WebKit RSS includes new WebKit helpers absent before launch; XPC parentage cannot exclude unrelated helpers launched during the interval. Git RSS is sampled descendants only and can miss short-lived peaks. Summed RSS may double-count shared pages; it is not JS heap or total GPU allocation.
soak-release-foreground.idle_sleep_guard: Temporary task-owned caffeinate -di tied to native PID; prevents display idle sleep only during foreground sampling; no preferences changed or session unlocked
